svg.title: The editor's page: frontend/editor/
svg.desc: The canvas, a node opened in place, the GUI designer, the schedule table, the notebook link and the settings. 136 rows: each file with what it does.
svg.text: The canvas, a node opened in place, the GUI designer, the schedule table, the notebook link and the settings. (136 rows)
